Tile(axes=(a0_b in 0..4 window(parent=a0 in 0..32), a1_b in 0..32 window(parent=a1 in 0..1024), a0_u in 0..8, a1_u in 0..16), block_threads=128, raster_axes=(a0_b, a1_b)):
    init f32 acc0__c0_0 = 0
    init f32 acc0__c0_1 = 0
    TmaDescriptor(name=_desc_a, src_buf=a, src_shape=(), box_extents=(1, 8, 128))
    TmaDescriptor(name=_desc_b, src_buf=b, src_shape=(), box_extents=(128, 32))
    Smem(name=_a_smem, extents=(16, 128), align=128)
    Smem(name=_b_smem, extents=(256, 32), align=128)
    Smem(name=_mbar, extents=(2), dtype=`unsigned long long`)
    if a0_u * 16 + a1_u == 0:
        MbarrierInit(mbar=_mbar, slot=0)
        MbarrierInit(mbar=_mbar, slot=1)
    Sync
    if a0_u * 16 + a1_u == 0:
        MbarrierArriveExpectTx(mbar=_mbar, bytes_=20480, slot=0)
        TmaLoad(smem=_a_smem, smem_index=(0, 0), desc=_desc_a, coords=(0, a0_b * 8, 0), mbar=_mbar, mbar_slot=0)
        TmaLoad(smem=_b_smem, smem_index=(0, 0), desc=_desc_b, coords=(0, a1_b * 32), mbar=_mbar, mbar_slot=0)
    for _ks in 0..1024 step 128:
        if a0_u * 16 + a1_u == 0:
            MbarrierArriveExpectTx(mbar=_mbar, bytes_=20480, slot=(_ks / 128 + 1) % 2)
            TmaLoad(smem=_a_smem, smem_index=((_ks / 128 + 1) % 2 * 8, 0), desc=_desc_a, coords=(0, a0_b * 8, _ks + 128 < 1024 ? _ks + 128 : 896), mbar=_mbar, mbar_slot=(_ks / 128 + 1) % 2)
            TmaLoad(smem=_b_smem, smem_index=((_ks / 128 + 1) % 2 * 128, 0), desc=_desc_b, coords=(_ks + 128 < 1024 ? _ks + 128 : 896, a1_b * 32), mbar=_mbar, mbar_slot=(_ks / 128 + 1) % 2)
        MbarrierWait(mbar=_mbar, phase=_ks / 128 / 2 % 2, slot=_ks / 128 % 2)
        for _ki in 0..128 seed=false:
            in0__c0_0 = load _a_smem[_ks / 128 % 2 * 8 + (a0_b * 8 + a0_u * 1 + 0 - a0_b * 8), _ki]
            in1__c0_0 = load _b_smem[_ks / 128 % 2 * 128 + _ki, a1_b * 32 + a1_u * 2 + 0 - a1_b * 32]
            f32 acc0__v__c0_0 = multiply(in1__c0_0, in0__c0_0)
            f32 acc0__c0_0 <- add(acc0__c0_0, acc0__v__c0_0) over _ki
            in1__c0_1 = load _b_smem[_ks / 128 % 2 * 128 + _ki, a1_b * 32 + a1_u * 2 + 1 - a1_b * 32]
            f32 acc0__v__c0_1 = multiply(in1__c0_1, in0__c0_0)
            f32 acc0__c0_1 <- add(acc0__c0_1, acc0__v__c0_1) over _ki
        Sync
    f32 o[0, a0_b * 8 + a0_u * 1 + 0, a1_b * 32 + a1_u * 2 + 0] = (acc0__c0_0, acc0__c0_1)
